notes: Use NodeRingIndex/CellRingIndex for the one-based concentric ring number within a wheel; 0 denotes points/cells outside the four wheel assemblies.
old_node_region is the original neural-network nodal patch ID. node_geometry/cell_geometry carry revised active geometric identifiers.
node_assignment_source is 0 for body incident-element assignment, 2 for orphan points, 3 for wheel points assigned directly by cylindrical radius.
SubregionID gives the explicit row key for each strict element region. Use searchsorted on SubregionID for a known region ID; gaps are permitted.
CSR NodeToSubregionIndptr and NodeToSubregionIDs describe every real subregion incident to a mesh vertex, including shared interfaces.
ElementRow is zero-based within solver storage family. Beams and discrete elements share the same storage family; SourceElementKind distinguishes them.
